_provenance: Electricity distribution (EDTI, AUC-regulated) + natural-gas delivery (ATCO Gas North)
residential tariffs, plus the two City-of-Edmonton franchise-fee percentages.
$0.69953/day + energy $0.01712/kWh (distribution only). Local Access Fee / franchise fee
GAS (ATCO Gas North Low-Use residential, Decision 30301-D01-2025, effective 2026-01-01):
fixed $0.997/day + variable $1.049/GJ + Rider T transmission $1.357/GJ + Rider L
load-balancing $0.091/GJ. Edmonton gas franchise fee (Rider A) = 35.00% of gross delivery
revenue (effective 2019-01-01). Rider B (5.60% property-tax rider) EXCLUDED - it is a
property-tax pass-through, not a franchise fee.
CONSUMPTION PROXIES (flat, per dwelling): electricity 7,200 kWh/yr (600 kWh/mo);
natural gas 115 GJ/yr (midpoint of the ~110-120 GJ/yr UCA typical-household range).
MODELING CAVEAT: the franchise fee is levied on the utility's FULL distribution/delivery
revenue (riders, pass-throughs, adjustments), not just the base DAS-R / delivery schedule
modeled here - so the modeled LAF runs ~1/3 UNDER the City's published per-customer figure
(~$8.33/mo = ~$100/yr in 2026). The per-hood SHAPE is unaffected (linear in dwellings).
Everything computed from these is MODELED, not billed (SPEC_utilities.md Lens 3).
Electricity/gas rates reset each Jan 1 - re-pull before any production claim.
